subject: [PATCH v4 5/7] sched/numa: scan PID-inactive VMAs for promotion

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: The patch author's original message was acknowledged with an Acked-by tag, indicating that the reviewer has no objections to the patch. However, there is currently no in-depth technical discussion or review of the patch.

2026-09-30.patch_summary: This patch series enhances the vma scanning logic in the Linux kernel's scheduler to promote hot memory tiers more effectively. The current implementation skips VMAs without recent PID activity, but this can lead to inefficient memory usage and performance issues. The patches introduce a new mechanism to bypass the PID scan filter for combined mode and restrict top-tier sampling to VMAs that need it.
